description.value: Little Engine Wines is a boutique winery and tasting room situated on Naramata Road along the Naramata Bench, one of the Okanagan's most celebrated cycling corridors. The tasting room pours across multiple wine series — Elevation, Silver, Gold, and Platinum — and offers a small bites food menu alongside wine club membership. The winery also hosts events and weddings, making it a destination stop rather than just a bottle shop.
